1. In a regular octahedron, the third vertices of two faces sharing an edge are opposite vertices of the octahedron.
2. Faces \(RST\) and \(RTV\) share edge \(RT\), so \(V\) is opposite \(S\).
3. Faces \(RST\) and \(RSQ\) share edge \(RS\), so \(Q\) is opposite \(T\).
4. Faces \(RSQ\) and \(RPQ\) share edge \(RQ\), so \(P\) is opposite \(S\).

Thus \(P\) and \(V\) coincide when folded. Therefore edge \(x=RV\) coincides with edge \(C=RP\).
